name: Spatial Launcher
summary: Spatial Launcher transforms how you interact with Android apps, web tools, games, and e-books in Virtual Reality. Built from the ground up for Meta Quest, it provides a seamless multi-panel spatial environment paired with real-time 2D-to-SBS 3D conversion, OCR zones, and offline text-to-speech capabilities.
